subject.title: fix(secrets): degrade stale auth profile refs on startup

question: Should this PR preserve existing automatic auth fallback and setup/inheritance behavior before the startup-isolation change is merged?
rationale: The intended startup fix is valid, but the current fail-closed expansion changes upgrade-sensitive auth behavior and needs explicit ownership of the compatibility boundary.

options.title: Repair before merge
options.body: Preserve startup isolation while restoring automatic fallback, setup reuse, inherited snapshots, and ref-matched recovery.

options.title: Narrow the PR
options.body: Limit this PR to startup owner isolation and defer terminal request-time unavailable semantics to separate design work.
